title: OFM machine state
description: Payload of {enterprise}/{site}/{area}/{line}/{machine}/state (ADR-0006, step 3a.3): the machine's current state, published retained on every change; the same shape as a live value, with v a state name. ts is when the state began: it is not republished while it lasts, so its age is the state's duration. unknown always has q bad. An empty retained message clears the topic of a machine that no longer has state rules.

v.description: The state, from the fixed vocabulary (config.machine_state).
